name: JellyVote
description: Community voting to delete movies, series, and music from your Jellyfin library.
overview: Vote before media is removed — adaptive quorum, preset reasons, and safe deletion defaults.

versions.changelog:
- Initial release: deletion voting with adaptive quorum
- Enhanced-style multi-tab settings
- Web client propose/vote UI and inbox
- Library-only or disk delete (setting)
- Notifications, audit log, dry-run mode
